none.help_text: Passes raw structural text chunks straight to the embedding model without additions.

metadata_tagging.help_text: Appends SDO specifications, working group scopes, and document headers into the token string.

acronym_expansion.help_text: Scans chunk text against a fixed dictionary of telecom acronyms and appends extensions.

llm_metadata.help_text: Uses an LLM agent to analyze text context and dynamically prepend inline entity translations.
